logp.method_description: PtNP (5 × 10–5 M) was resolved in PBS and culture medium containing DMSO (0.3%). The UV–vis absorption spectra of PtNP were determined on a Specord 200 UV–visible spectrophotometer under physiological conditions (pH 7.4, 37 °C). The lipophilicity (log PO/W) of PtNP was measured in a 1-octanol/buffer system using the shake-flask method. Solutions of PtNP (50, 100, 150 μM) were prepared in PBS (pH 7.4) presaturated with octanol. Equal volumes (2.0 mL) of the solution and octanol presaturated with PBS were mixed and shaken at room temperature for 24 h and then separated into two phases by centrifugation. The concentration of the solute in the aqueous phase was determined by spectrophotometry. The log PO/W value was calculated using the equation: log P = log((C_initial - C_final) / C_final) The log P values were calculated from the average of three independent measurements.
